answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Every claim climbs the comet of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the umber re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. What survives to the quill is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
